title: Heidi and Library (hard)
statementMd:
The good times at Heidi's library are over. Marmots finally got their internet connections and stopped coming to the library altogether. Not only that, but the bookstore has begun charging extortionate prices for some books. Namely, whereas in the previous versions each book could be bought for 1 CHF, now the price of book $*i*$ is $*c*_{*i*}$ CHF.

## Input

The first line of input will contain two integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ (![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1fcb9de4700dce1c302f6e6f7941707f942bc3ff.png)). The second line will contain $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$) – the sequence of book requests. The third line contains $*n*$ integers $*c*_{1}, *c*_{2}, ..., *c*_{*n*}$ ($0 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$) – the costs of the books.

## Output

On a single line print the minimum cost of buying books at the store so as to satisfy all requests.

## Note

The first three sample cases are repeated, but the fourth one is new.

In the fourth test case, when buying book $3$, Heidi should discard either book $1$ or $2$. Even though book $2$ will be requested later than book $1$, she should keep it, because it is so expensive to buy again.
statementZhMd:
Heidi 图书馆的美好时光结束了。土拨鼠们终于接入了互联网，彻底不再光顾图书馆。不仅如此，书店还开始对某些书籍收取高昂的价格。具体来说，在之前的版本中，每本书都可以用 1 瑞士法郎购买，而现在第 $*i*$ 本书的价格为 $*c*_{*i*}$ 瑞士法郎。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$ (![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1fcb9de4700dce1c302f6e6f7941707f942bc3ff.png))。第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$)，表示书籍请求序列。第三行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*c*_{1}, *c*_{2}, ..., *c*_{*n*}$ ($0 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$)，表示书籍的价格。

## 输出格式

在一行中输出购买书籍以满足所有请求所需的最小花费。

## 说明

前三个样例与之前相同，但第四个样例是新增的。

在第四个测试用例中，购买第 $3$ 本书时，Heidi 应该丢弃第 $1$ 本书或第 $2$ 本书中的一本。尽管之后请求第 $2$ 本书的时间晚于请求第 $1$ 本书的时间，她仍然应该保留第 $2$ 本书，因为重新购买它的价格非常昂贵。
